summary: Iran has declared a "final decision" to prepare for a comprehensive multi-layered war and threatens unrestricted retaliation against any attack, marking the most significant escalation signal. Pro-Iranian hackers claim infiltration of IDF bases and publication of sensitive military footage. Simultaneously, Saudi-led coalition intercepted four drones targeting the Kingdom, while Israeli artillery and drone strikes hit central and southern Gaza.
key_points: Iranian security source tells Press TV Tehran will respond to any attack or assassination "without any restrictions" and forces are ready to strike any enemy target and allied interests in the region. (Source: @yediotnews25/136573)

Pro-Iranian hacker group Handala claims breach of IDF bases, releasing video of command centers, meeting rooms, and military equipment, likely via compromised personal phones. (Source: @yediotnews25/136579)
Pakistan Army Chief Asim Munir requested Iran remove 400kg of 60% enriched uranium during Tehran visit; Iran refused outright. (Source: @yediotnews25/136586)
Saudi-led coalition intercepted and destroyed four drones launched toward the Kingdom. (Source: @shin_persian/11336)
IDF artillery fired toward eastern Al-Bureij in central Gaza; drone strike near Khan Yunis mosque wounded two Palestinians, one seriously. (Source: @yediotnews25/136571, @yediotnews25/136581)

Lebanese artillery shelled Zoutar Al-Sharqiya; hostile drone hovered over Beirut's Mazraa, Mar Elias, Basta districts; Lebanese Army conducted controlled explosion in Qlaileh field. (Source: @redlinkleb/49043, @redlinkleb/48980, @redlinkleb/48997)

Large explosion reported in Khomeini Shahr, Isfahan; Iranian F-5 fighters active over Dezful, Khuzestan; jet activity over central Tehran. (Source: @shin_persian/11327, @shin_persian/11341, @shin_persian/11334)
French President Macron arrived in Saudi Arabia for official visit. (Source: @N12chat/231062)

sections.threat_assessment: Iran's explicit declaration of a "final decision" for unrestricted multi-layered warfare represents a significant threshold shift, moving from calibrated responses to open-ended escalation. The Handala hack claim, if verified, demonstrates advanced cyber capability targeting Israeli military C2 infrastructure. Concurrent drone activity over Beirut and Saudi intercepts indicate a coordinated axis pressure campaign. The Pakistani uranium demand reveals international concern over Iran's nuclear breakout potential, while Iranian air activity over Khuzestan and Isfahan suggests heightened defensive readiness.
sections.regional_response: Saudi Arabia's successful interception of four drones showcases effective integrated air defense but underscores persistent Houthi/Iranian proxy threat. France's Macron visit to Riyadh signals European diplomatic engagement amid Gulf security anxieties. Lebanon's military detonation in Qlaileh and drone overflights reflect continued Israeli aerial dominance and Lebanese Army attempts to manage southern front. Pakistan's direct nuclear demand to Tehran highlights Islamabad's strategic stake in preventing regional nuclearization.
sections.intelligence_notes: The Handala hack likely exploited personal device vulnerabilities rather than classified networks, but operational security implications for IDF personnel are severe. Iranian F-5 operations over Dezful (Khuzestan) may indicate protection of critical oil/nuclear infrastructure. The Khomeini Shahr explosion warrants monitoring for potential sabotage or accident at nearby facilities. Israeli artillery in Al-Bureij and Khan Yunis drone strike suggest continued pressure on Hamas remnants in central/southern Gaza. Absence of Syrian/Iraq reporting may indicate operational pause or reporting gap.
